penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Unblocking Salesforce 2GP namespace linking and AppExchange security review requires per-customer diagnosis, guided Salesforce org configuration, and potentially direct engagement with Salesforce support — each engagement needs hands-on human judgement.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: The core value proposition (diagnosing and resolving a platform bug in a customer's specific Salesforce org configuration) realistically requires synchronous sessions or at minimum async back-and-forth requiring human judgement at each step.

rationale: Salesforce ISVs are excellent B2B buyers — specific roles, clear revenue motivation, and a $500–2,000 unblocking fee has obvious ROI against AppExchange revenue. However, this is fundamentally a consulting/done-for-you engagement: each customer's Salesforce org has unique configuration, and resolving PKCE errors or security portal issues requires per-customer manual diagnosis and likely synchronous communication. Operational autonomy scores 4 because there is no way to automate per-customer Salesforce org access and debugging at this level. The penalties reduce the total to 3.3, reflecting that this is a high-value but human-intensive service that does not fit the autonomous-factory model.
solution_plan: This cannot realistically be built and run by a solo non-technical operator using an automated Claude factory. The core task — diagnosing and resolving blocking bugs in a specific customer's Salesforce Developer Edition org, navigating Salesforce's security review process, and coordinating with Salesforce partner support — requires hands-on technical expertise and synchronous customer interaction for every engagement. A Claude-generated diagnostic guide or checklist could be sold as a one-time PDF/template, but that is a low-ticket information product with limited defensibility. Unless reframed as a purely documentation/template asset (no per-customer service), this should be dropped in favour of ideas that can run hands-off.
notes: Failing build gates: operational_autonomy=4 (below floor of 7) and total of 3.3 is below min_total_to_validate. The opportunity has strong commercial signal but is structurally incompatible with the autonomous-factory model.
